Our Services

Our WALSCOM technicians at work — installing, configuring, and delivering reliable ICT solutions across Nigeria.

WhatsApp: 08037945050

CCTV Installation & Surveillance

Our WALSCOM technicians design and install high-definition CCTV camera systems for homes, offices, and industrial sites across Nigeria. We configure remote viewing on mobile devices, set up NVR/DVR recording, and ensure full coverage with zero blind spots. Every installation includes proper cable management, weatherproofing for outdoor cameras, and comprehensive testing before handover.

Surveillance

Networking & Structured Cabling

From small office networks to enterprise-grade infrastructure, WALSCOM engineers deliver reliable networking solutions. We install and configure switches, routers, wireless access points, and complete structured cabling with proper labeling and testing. Our team ensures your network runs at optimal speed with minimal downtime, using industry-standard cable management and documentation.

Networking

Fiber Optic Installation & Splicing

WALSCOM provides professional fiber optic cable installation, splicing, and termination services for telecommunications and enterprise backbone networks. Our certified technicians handle single-mode and multi-mode fiber, perform OTDR testing, and ensure low-loss connections that meet international standards. We deliver reliable high-bandwidth connectivity for data centers, campus networks, and ISP backbones.

Fiber Optics

Access Control & Biometric Systems

Secure your premises with WALSCOM access control solutions. We install fingerprint readers, facial recognition terminals, RFID card systems, and electromagnetic locks. Our technicians integrate access control with existing security infrastructure, configure time-attendance tracking, and set up centralized management software so you control who enters your facility at all times.

Access Control

Solar-Powered Security Systems

WALSCOM designs and installs solar-powered CCTV and security systems for locations without reliable grid power. Our technicians size solar panels and battery banks for 24/7 operation, integrate charge controllers, and ensure your surveillance runs uninterrupted even during power outages. Ideal for remote sites, construction zones, and off-grid locations across Nigeria.

Solar Security

Projects

Real installations delivered for clients across Nigeria — from small offices to large-scale deployments.

Oil & Gas Facility Surveillance

Lagos

Complete CCTV and access control deployment for a major oil and gas facility in Lagos. 64-camera system with central monitoring, ANPR at gate, and biometric access at all entry points. Integrated with existing SCADA network.

Bank Branch Network

Abuja

Full structured cabling and network infrastructure for a banking headquarters in Abuja. 500+ data points, fiber backbone between floors, redundant core switching, and enterprise Wi-Fi coverage across all floors.

Solar-Powered Remote CCTV

Port Harcourt

Off-grid solar-powered surveillance installation for a construction site in Port Harcourt. 12 cameras running 24/7 on solar with 3-day battery autonomy, remote monitoring via 4G, and motion-activated alerts.

ISP Fiber Backbone

Multiple Cities

Fiber optic backbone installation for an ISP spanning multiple cities. Over 40km of underground and aerial fiber, complete with splicing, OTDR testing, and commissioning. Delivered with full documentation and as-built drawings.

Our Process

From initial consultation to handover — a proven approach that delivers results every time.

🔍

1. Site Survey

We visit your site, assess requirements, identify optimal camera and cable routes, and document everything. No guesswork — every installation starts with a thorough professional survey.

📄

2. Design & Quote

We produce a detailed system design with equipment specifications, cable routes, and a transparent quotation. You know exactly what you are getting before any work begins on site.

🔧

3. Installation

Our WALSCOM technicians carry out professional installation with clean cable management, proper labeling, and industry-standard termination. We treat every site like our own office.

✅

4. Testing & Handover

Every cable is tested, every camera is focused, and every access point is verified. We provide full documentation, train your team, and offer ongoing after-install support.

Frequently Asked Questions

Common questions about our ICT engineering services and how we work.

We operate across Nigeria with primary presence in Lagos, Abuja, and Port Harcourt. Our team travels to project sites nationwide including remote locations. For large deployments we mobilize from our nearest regional office. Contact us on WhatsApp at 08037945050 to confirm availability in your area.
A standard 8-camera residential installation typically takes 1 to 2 working days. Commercial installations of 16 to 64 cameras usually require 3 to 7 working days depending on site complexity and cable routing requirements. We always provide a timeline during the quotation phase so you can plan accordingly.
Yes, every WALSCOM installation comes with a warranty period and after-install support. We provide remote troubleshooting, on-site maintenance visits, and system health checks. We also offer annual maintenance contracts for clients who want guaranteed response times and regular preventive maintenance.
Absolutely. All our installations include mobile app configuration so you can view live feeds and playback recordings from anywhere using your smartphone. We support both Android and iOS platforms, and we configure secure remote access with proper authentication to protect your privacy.
We work with trusted brands including Hikvision, Dahua, and Axis for CCTV; Cisco, Ubiquiti, and TP-Link for networking; ZKteco and Suprema for access control; and Huawei and Corning for fiber optics. We select equipment based on project requirements and budget while maintaining quality and reliability standards.
